answer_prose: Across 2,512,860 Smyth-valid finishers in the current dump, continuous wall severity (distance-weighted mean of positive second-half slowdown) averages 0.117 (median 0.090). Band mix: none 53.9%, mild 35.2%, moderate 8.7%, severe 2.1%. Binary HTW stays separate: severity fills the spectrum below the paper threshold while keeping Smyth’s flag untouched.
methodology_prose: Severity uses gap_substrate.severity.compute_severity on the Analyst feature dump: second-half segment DoS (pace vs Smyth base pace from 5–20 km), negatives floored at 0, then distance-weighted mean. Bands: none [0,0.10), mild [0.10,0.25), moderate [0.25,0.40), severe ≥0.40. Smyth binary HTW (s=0.25, d=5 km after 20 km) unchanged. Tables use valid_splits only (n_features=3,167,990). No invented weather/elev; race_records untouched.
